Comprehensive experiments on publicly available datasets show that REC-CBM consistently improves grading performance and produces more faithful concept-level reasoning than both state-of-the-art baselines. Further analyses validate the contribution of each component and demonstrate the applicability in realistic educational settings. Overall, this work provides a practical, interpretable grading solution that enables educators to inspect, intervene in, and trust automated decisions, advancing more transparent and trustworthy education.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 REC-CBM（Rubric-Aware Error-Correction Concept Bottleneck Model），面向开放题评分的可信赖（可信）自动化评分系统。它将评分过程路由通过人类可解释的 rubric 概念瓶颈，在保持或超越黑盒模型（PLM/LLM）评分性能的同时，输出可审计、可干预的概念级推理。作者在 Mohler、ASAP 2.0、MOCHA 三个公开数据集上人工标注了 rubric 对齐的概念标签，并通过概念查询库、序数成对校准、潜在概念误差校正三个模块及两阶段训练实现该框架。
AI.motivation: 开放题（主观题）评分是教育评估的核心，但人工评分离线成本高、耗时长。现有神经模型与 LLM 评分器虽是黑盒，教师无法核查评分理由、无法在模型判断可疑时干预，限制了教育场景中的信任与落地。概念瓶颈模型（CBM）提供了预测必须经过可解释概念的机制性透明保证，但标准 CBM 未针对开放题评分设计：(1) 假设所有概念共享同一潜在表征空间，无法区分不同 rubric 维度关注的作答内容；(2) 将概念等级视为等距无序类别，丢弃 rubric 标注中的序数/排序信息；(3) 默认人工概念标签可靠，忽略评分者分歧、rubric 维度重叠、开放作答歧义带来的测量误差，导致性能下降并削弱概念解释的可信度。因此需要一种既面向 rubric、又显式建模序数语义与标注噪声的可解释评分框架。
AI.method: 任务形式化为序数多分类：输入 x=(q, r, a)（题目、学生作答、参考答案/rubric 等辅助上下文），目标为序数分数 y∈{0..S}，评测用任务级 Accuracy/macro-F1 与概念级 Accuracy/macro-F1，数据 7:2:1 划分，5 个随机种子平均。方法三组件：(1) Rubric-Aware Concept Encoder (RACE)：预训练文本编码器得到 token 表征 H，引入可学习的概念查询库 Q（由随机高斯矩阵 QR 正交分解初始化以获得跨概念多样模式），按软注意力 α_{k,t}=exp(q_k^T H_t/τ)/Σ… 聚合得到各概念专属表征 h_k，再用逐概念线性分类器 V_k 输出序数分布 p̂_k，损失为各概念交叉熵之和 L_con。(2) Ordinal Pairwise Concept Calibration (OPCC)：由分布期望得序数得分 ĉ_k=Σ m·p̂_{k,m}，在 batch 内按标注构造合法比较对 P_k={(i,j): c_k^(i)>c_k^(j)}，用 Bradley–Terry 式 logistic 排序损失 L_rank^(k)=−mean log σ(ĉ_k^(i)−ĉ_k^(j))，在有有效对的 K′ 个概念上平均。(3) Latent Concept Error Correction (LCEC)：设归一化观测 s̃=ĉ/M 为潜在概念向量 z 的含噪观测（z~N(0,Ω^{-1})，噪声 D=diag(σ_k²)，σ_k²=exp(η_k)），由高斯后验闭式解 μ_post=(Ω+D^{-1})^{-1}D^{-1}s̃=A s̃ 作为去噪后的概念向量（Proposition 1 证明其为 MMSE 估计，对角情形退化为 Spearman 信度系数与标量 Wiener 滤波）；Ω=LL^T+εI 保证正定，稀疏正则 L_spa=Σ_{i>j}|L_ij| 抑制跨概念依赖；最终 ŷ=W μ_post。训练采用两阶段：Stage I 以 λ_c L_con + λ_r L_rank 训练编码器/查询库/逐概念分类器后冻结；Stage II 在冻结概念输出上以 λ_t L_task + λ_d L_den + λ_s L_spa 拟合 (L, η, W)，避免任务损失回传扭曲可解释瓶颈。此外构建了人机协同（HITL）标注流程：三位领域专家设计概念清单与各等级锚定描述，由 GPT-4o 与 Gemini-2.5-pro 生成初始概念标注，专家独立复核并以讨论+多数投票定稿。基线包括 5 个微调 PLM、零/少样本 LLM（Llama-3-8B、Qwen2.5-14B、Mistral-7B）及 4 个 CBM 变体（Vanilla CBM、C³M、CT-CBM、CB-LLM）。
AI.result: 主结果（Table 2）：REC-CBM 在 3 数据集 × 5 骨干的全部 15 个同骨干区块中取得最佳 T-Acc 与 T-F1，并在 15 个场景中 14 个取得最佳 C-F1（唯一例外为 BART/ASAP 2.0，CT-CBM C-F1 0.573 vs REC-CBM 0.513，但 T-F1 仍领先）。相较最强黑盒 PLM，RoBERTa+REC-CBM 在三数据集 T-F1 分别为 0.570/0.545/0.530，优于 RoBERTa PLM 的 0.563/0.526/0.514；相较 Vanilla CBM，五骨干中位数提升 T-F1 +6.3/+1.9/+1.9，C-F1 +2.3/+3.1/+2.6，最大单格提升为 GPT-2/Mohler T-F1 0.298→0.615。提示型 LLM 显著落后（如 Qwen2.5-14B 在 Mohler T-Acc 仅 0.070）；CB-LLM 恒定 T-F1 0.077/0.094/0.131 显示多数类塌缩；CT-CBM 在 GPT-2 上急剧退化（Mohler T-F1 0.110）。消融显示去掉任一组件至少在两个数据集下降，去掉 RACE 损害最大（−RACE−OPCC 在 MOCHA 使 T-ACC 近乎减半）。超参分析：K≈4 后饱和、d≥384 几乎不敏感，仅 Stage I 学习率敏感（峰值在 1e-5~1e-4，≥1e-3 全面塌缩）。人工干预：Oracle/Wrong/Random 替换 top-k 概念，Wrong 与 Random 单调下降最多 30–45 个准确率点，Oracle 与 None 持平或略高（Mohler +5、ASAP +6、MOCHA +3），呈现忠实性契约。潜在去噪分析显示学习到的 Ω 偏相关矩阵显著稀疏于经验相关矩阵，保留 FC–CC、FC–DU、R–FR 等可解释残差链接及 EE–FR=−0.63 等"深度 vs 表层"抑制关系。案例研究给出单条 Mohler 回答的可读决策轨迹：token 注意力、序数预测与 LCEC 收缩（约 0.51 均匀收缩）、各概念对等级 logit 的可加贡献（合计 3.32，对应置信度 0.863）。
AI.conclusion: REC-CBM 通过 rubric 感知概念编码、序数成对校准与潜在概念误差校正三个互补模块，配合两阶段训练，在开放题评分上同时提升评分精度与概念级推理忠实性，在同骨干比较中整体优于黑盒 PLM/LLM 与既有 CBM 基线；其瓶颈具备可检查、可干预、可审计的机制性透明性，为教育场景中的可信自动化评分提供了实用方案，并配套发布了带 rubric 对齐概念标注的资源与代码。局限方面：rubric 与概念标注为英文且与基准强绑定，迁移到新语言/学科需重做 HITL 流程；Stage I 对学习率敏感，Stage II 头在 one-hot oracle 替换下存在分布外衰减。论文将 GPT-5.4 仅用作语言润色工具，未参与科研内容生成。未来工作为扩展到多语与特定领域评估，并结合教师在环的 rubric 迭代优化。

title: Efficient and Scalable Provenance Tracking for LLM-Generated Code Snippets
summary: Large language models (LLMs) for code completion and generation are increasingly used in software development, yet they may reproduce training examples verbatim and without authorship attribution, raising legal and ethical concerns around plagiarism and license compliance. Classical fingerprint-based plagiarism detectors based on fingerprinting, such as Winnowing, remain highly effective, yet the inspection requires comparing fragments of code to the entire training set, and their linear-time search makes them impractical for the billion-scale corpora used to train modern code LLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SOURCETRACKER, a 300M-parameter encoder tailored for code retrieval, together with a hybrid two-stage provenance-tracking pipeline HYBRIDSOURCETRACKER (HST). HST first narrows down a small set of candidate snippets via vector search, then re-ranks those candidates using Winnowing on exact fingerprints. We train and evaluate our system on a 10M-snippet subset of the THESTACKV2 dataset, with both verbatim and adapted snippets that emulate realistic identifier renaming. On an in vitro 100k-snippet search space with adapted queries, our hybrid approach reaches a mean reciprocal rank on par with Winnowing for 30-token fragments. Then, starting from windows >= 60 tokens, it consistently over-performs by up to 5.4% while preserving logarithmic-time query complexity. In a complementary evaluation using an LLM-based judge, we find that many retrieved snippets not labeled as ground truth are still highly similar to the expected sources, particularly with longer context windows, and thus remain useful for end users. Overall, our results demonstrate that integrating vector search with fingerprinting enables scalable, high-precision provenance tracking for code produced by LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HybridSourceTracker (HST)：一个由 300M 参数代码检索编码器 SourceTracker（基于 MoSE 前 9 层、用 CLIP 损失对比微调）+ 向量数据库 Qdrant（HNSW，对数复杂度）+ Winnowing 指纹重排序组成的两阶段溯源追踪流水线。在 TheStackV2 的 1000 万代码片段子集上训练评估：在 10 万片段的 in vitro 检索空间中，改写查询下 30 token 窗口时 HST 的 MRR 与纯 Winnowing 持平（68.9% vs 68.3%），窗口 ≥60 token 时稳定超越基线，最高提升约 5.4%，同时保持对数级查询复杂度。
AI.motivation: 代码 LLM（Codex、CodeLlama、StarCoder 等）在训练中会记忆并逐字或经改写复现训练语料（"recitation"），且不带作者署名，带来抄袭、许可证合规与版权风险。经典基于指纹的检测方法（如 Winnowing/MOSS）虽抗噪、精度高，但需将代码片段与整个训练集比对，时间复杂度随数据集规模线性增长，难以支撑现代十亿级代码语料。另一方面，已有可扩展方案（如 OLMoTrace，基于 infini-gram/后缀数组）虽达到对数复杂度，但依赖连续逐字匹配，对标识符重命名等噪声高度敏感。论文的目标是构建一个能在十亿级语料上以对数时间检索、并对任意长度 LLM 生成片段给出最相似来源代码片段及其作者/许可证元数据的系统。
AI.method: 1）数据：从 TheStackV2 随机抽取 1000 万代码片段，从完整片段中切出 token 窗口作为查询，天然保留 ground truth；10% 作测试集。通过 Algorithm 1（RepFreqWords：对长度>3 且出现>2 次的词以 20% 概率整体替换为 8 位随机串）模拟 Type 2（重命名）克隆，其余为 Type 1 逐字克隆。2）SourceTracker：以 ModularStarEncoder (MoSE) 前 9 层（300M 参数）为基础的双向编码器，输出 1024 维向量；用 CLIP 对比损失在"片段—完整片段"对上训练（batch 2048，2000 步，AdamW，lr 6e-4，500 步 warmup），训练中 50% 使用改写片段；查询片段固定 60 token（参考 Ziegler 的阈值）。3）索引与检索：以 Qdrant（基于 HNSW，O(log N)）做 ANN 检索取 top-100 候选。4）重排序：对 100 个候选用 Winnowing（k=5、w=4、SHA-1 取低 16 位、高频哈希阈值 0.5%、64 次哈希检查预算）计算指纹集合，用精确 Jaccard 相似度排序，形成 HST，总复杂度为对数级。5）基线：纯 Winnowing/MOSS、SourceTracker 单独、OLMoTrace。6）评估指标：Recall@N、MRR，窗口 7–480 token，检索空间 1000/10000/100000；超参敏感性分析（候选池大小、高频阈值、替换概率）；并以 Qwen3 Coder 作为 LLM 裁判（1–5 分）评估"非 ground truth"检索结果与查询的实际相似度，用 Codestral 25.08、DeepSeek-v4-pro 做评审一致性检验（Krippendorff ordinal α、Spearman）。
AI.result: 在 10 万片段检索空间、Type 2 改写查询上（Table 5，MRR %）：7 token 时 Winnowing 20.4 优于 HST 10.5、SourceTracker 5.5；15 token 时 Winnowing 46.0 > HST 35.0；30 token 起 HST 反超并持续领先（68.9 vs 68.3 vs 53.8）；60 token 时 HST 89.6 明显高于 Winnowing 84.2 与 SourceTracker 81.2；120/240/480 token 时 HST 分别为 95.4/98.2/99.3，均为最优。复杂度方面：MOSS/Winnowing 单查询延迟呈近线性（幂律拟合 b≈1.06），Qdrant 呈对数增长，外推至 10^11 样本仍为毫秒级。敏感性：MRR 在候选池 50–100 之间饱和（重排序均 <1 ms），高频阈值从 0.25% 提升到 0.5% 带来 +13.9 MRR 点。替换概率从 10% 增至 60% 时，Winnowing/SourceTracker/HST 平均 MRR 分别下降 4.5/4.8/4.0 点，HST 在所有取值下最强。OLMoTrace 在 7 token 尚可（MRR 26.1，优于 HST 15.6），但 30 token 起大幅落后 HST（差距 -29.7 至 -45.3 点），原因是标识符重命名会打断其最大逐字跨度。LLM 裁判评估显示：HST 未命中 ground truth 的检索结果与查询仍有可观相似度，平均分随窗口增大从 1.36 升至 2.63（ground truth 从 3.47 升至 4.91）；三评审 ordinal α=0.651，82.57% 案例评分差异不超过 1 分，Spearman 0.670–0.765；置换 ANOVA 显示窗口长度影响显著（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 向量检索与指纹检测的串联融合可以在保留 Winnowing 检测精度的同时把查询复杂度从线性降为对数，为 LLM 生成代码提供可扩展的高精度来源追踪。论文强调三点结论：Winnowing 仍是最有效的检测方法之一但时间复杂度是其瓶颈；微调编码器在长片段上表现更优且可借助 HNSW 实现对数查询；两阶段混合在 ≥30 token 窗口下同时取得最好的效果与效率。论文明确声明的方法边界与局限：(1) HST 只做来源检索，不判定记忆、不判定抄袭、不从编码风格推断作者，作者归属依赖来源元数据（如 TheStackV2/SWHID 可映射到仓库、提交与作者）；(2) 仅覆盖 Type 1/Type 2 克隆，Type 3（近失配）与 Type 4（语义克隆）留待未来工作；(3) 根本前提是训练数据可访问——对未公开训练数据的模型该方法无法适用，因此作者将"训练语料透明/可查询"视为负责任部署的前提条件，并结合 EU AI Act 第 53 条的训练数据摘要披露要求呼吁更广泛的透明度，同时呼吁建立多语言、含 Type 1–4 修改等级与真实 LLM 输出的社区标准基准。

title: Agyn: An Open-Source Platform for AI Agents with Scalable On-Demand Execution, Agent Definition as a Code, and Zero-Trust Access
summary: As organizations move toward production deployments of AI agents, which execute non-deterministic workflows, maintain stateful sessions, and often operate with privileged access to internal services, the engineering challenge shifts from building individual agents to operating them at scale with proper isolation, governance, and security. In this paper we present Agyn, an open-source platform designed around three key principles tailored for agent workloads: a signal-driven, stateful serverless runtime on Kubernetes; a Terraform provider for agent and harness definition; and a security model grounded in zero-trust and least-privilege principles. Agyn is agent-agnostic, model-agnostic, and cloud-agnostic.

AI.tldr: Agyn 是一个开源的 AI Agent 运行平台，针对"组织级规模智能体运营"这一问题提出三大设计原则：(1) 基于 Kubernetes 的信号驱动、有状态 Serverless 运行时（消息到达即按需拉起、空闲即回收，状态持久化可跨冷启动恢复）；(2) 通过 Terraform Provider 把 Agent 及其 harness（MCP 服务器、密钥、卷、网络身份等）以"代码即定义"方式纳管，支持版本控制与代码评审；(3) 基于零信任与最小权限的安全模型——每容器隔离与按需注入密钥、OpenZiti 提供每实例 x509 身份与 mTLS 覆盖网络、OpenFGA 提供 ReBAC 图遍历授权。平台对 Agent、模型、云均不绑定（agent/model/cloud-agnostic），采用 Go + PostgreSQL + Redis 实现，以 Helm Chart 交付，可自托管。论文以能力对照表（对比 AWS Bedrock AgentCore、Claude Managed Agents、Google AX、kagent）论证 Agyn 是唯一同时具备自托管、多厂商预置 Agent、MCP 隔离、声明式配置、Serverless、凭证隔离与零信任网络能力的平台，并指出按暴露面收敛 Dial-policy、硬性支出上限、ReBAC 覆盖扩展等为待改进项。
AI.motivation: 组织级 AI Agent 落地时的工程难点从"造一个 Agent"转向"规模化运营大量 Agent"。Agent 具有非确定性工作流、有状态会话、且常持有访问内部服务的特权；采用"单一定义、多实例、每实例绑定单一用户与单一任务（会话线程）"的部署形态时，暴露三项现有基础设施无法同时满足的需求：1) 高效按需执行——不能为每个 Agent 预置常驻算力，否则大量闲置计费，必须"用时才分配、闲置即回收"；2) Agent 定义即代码——Prompt、工具、密钥、资源边界属重要运维决策，需纳入版本控制与同行评审，可回滚，避免厂商控制台黑盒；3) 零信任访问内部服务——访问必须按身份授权、默认拒绝，凭证绝不能进入模型上下文或网络信任假设（需考虑间接提示注入导致凭证泄露），每次对数据库/API/消息队列的请求都需独立授权。现有方案各自只解决一部分：Knative/Lambda 具备弹性但缺有状态会话与 Agent 触发器；IaC 框架缺乏面向 Agent 工作负载的抽象；零信任网络需手工管理身份生命周期，与 Agent 的临时性执行不匹配。
AI.method: 系统架构分为控制面、数据面与三层核心能力。运行时层：Notifications 服务在消息到达时发布事件，Agents Orchestrator 订阅事件、判定需运行的 Agent、解析密钥、申请 OpenZiti 身份并指令 k8s-runner 创建 Pod；Pod 挂载持久卷保留工作区状态并接收线程上下文，实现"恢复而非重启"；Agent 每 10s 发 keep-alive，默认空闲 5 分钟后 Orchestrator 停止 Pod 并删除网络身份，持久卷与线程历史保留。配置层：Terraform Provider 声明 Agent 容器、工作区、系统 Prompt、模型、密钥、MCP 服务器、持久卷等完整 Agent 与 harness；内置 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex 及自研 agent-loop 三种预置镜像，也支持自定义容器；通过模块化打包复用常见 harness 模式，terraform apply 经 Gateway 解析进 Agents Service，后续消息即按新定义拉起 Pod，无需重启。安全层三重机制：(a) 每容器隔离——主容器跑 Agent 进程、sidecar 跑 MCP 服务器，独立文件系统与进程树、仅共享回环；密钥只注入需要它的容器（通常是 MCP sidecar），绝不进入驱动 LLM 的 Agent 容器；(b) OpenZiti 零信任覆盖网络——每次 spawn 签发独立 x509 身份，在 mTLS 握手阶段即确定调用方，Gateway 提取并沿调用链传播身份，ABAC 策略限定可访问服务；(c) OpenFGA（受 Zanzibar 启发）ReBAC 图遍历授权，按 Agent 角色（owner/maintainer/participant）约束配置与交互，线程访问按参与者范围限定。实现：平台服务用 Go 编写，PostgreSQL 为唯一持久存储，Redis 提供发布订阅事件分发；OpenZiti Go SDK 直接嵌入基础设施服务以避免与 Istio sidecar 冲突，Agent Pod 使用 Ziti TPROXY sidecar；并存三类身份生命周期模式（spawn 时创建的每工作负载临时身份、租约自注册的每 Pod 服务身份、服务令牌下发的持久 runner/app/device 身份），Ziti Management 服务封装 Controller API 并执行租约式垃圾回收；全套以 Helm Chart 打包，一键引导仓库部署 OpenZiti Controller 与平台服务。
AI.result: 论文给出 Table 1 的能力对照评测：Agyn 是所调研系统（AWS Bedrock AgentCore、Claude Managed Agents、Google AX、kagent）中唯一同时具备自托管、多厂商预置 Agent（Claude Code/Codex）、MCP 隔离、Agent-as-Code 声明式配置、Serverless 执行、凭证隔离与零信任网络七项能力的平台。对比结论：AgentCore 安全与配置需拼装 AWS IAM/VPC/Bedrock 且锁定 AWS、缺多租户 MCP 隔离；Claude Managed Agents 运行于 Anthropic 云、仅窄范围安全能力（Vaults、MCP Tunnels、API 白名单）；Google AX 为 K8s 原生分布式运行时并支持 A2A，但开源版缺凭证隔离与零信任；kagent 以 CRD 建模、声明式配置强，但以常驻 Deployment 运行且把模型凭证以 Pod 环境变量挂载。相对相关工作方面：LangGraph/AutoGen/CrewAI 是构建 Agent 的库，Agyn 则与框架无关地运营 Agent；IsolateGPT 是 API 层的按工具隔离，Agyn 将该原理提升到容器层；BeyondCorp 确立按设备身份，OpenZiti 将其延伸至跨信任边界的覆盖网络。
AI.conclusion: Agyn 通过三条支柱把"Agent 编排平台"从各自拼装变为一体化：信号驱动的有状态 Serverless 运行时兼顾 FaaS 弹性与对话式有状态特性；Terraform Provider 让 Agent 与 harness 获得与基础设施一致的治理（版本化、评审、可重复部署）；零信任安全栈（按容器注入密钥、OpenZiti 临时 x509 身份、ReBAC）确保即使 LLM 被攻陷也无法泄露凭证或越权访问。作者邀请社区扩展 Agent 目录与行业化策略模式，代码以 AGPL-3.0 开源于 github.com/agynio。已明确承认的局限与后续工作包括：按暴露面（per-exposure）收敛 Dial-policy 范围、硬性支出上限（spend-cap）强制执行、以及扩展 ReBAC 覆盖范围；此外论文以定性能力对照表而非基准性能实验作为"评估"，缺少量化弹性/时延/成本数据支撑。

title: Modeling Community Attitude through Reaction Tone: A Human-AI Collaborative Framework for Evaluating LLM Alignment with Linguistic Behaviors in Online Communities
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly utilized as proxies for computational social analysis; yet, their ability to faithfully represent the "thick descriptions" (Geertz, 1973) of human communities remains a critical challenge. Current evaluations often reduce social identity to static labels, sidelining how real-world groups navigate social shifts. To bridge this gap, we introduce CARE (Community-Aware Reaction Evaluation), a reaction-centered framework that benchmarks LLM-simulated discourse against the authentic, event-contingent responses of distinct communities to real-world news. By characterizing a fine-grained spectrum of illocutionary tones and the underlying attitudes they manifest--validated through human-AI collaboration--our diagnosis reveals a persistent "realism gap": steering LLMs with explicit community prompts fails to inherently improve simulation fidelity. Analysis further identifies divergent behavioral signatures among frontier models, suggesting that current alignment strategies remain insufficient for capturing the sociolinguistic dynamics of online groups.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CARE（Community-Aware Reaction Evaluation）框架与数据集：以「反应」为中心，把 LLM 模拟的 Reddit 社区发言与真实社区对 2,166 篇新闻的 9,947 条真实评论进行对照评估，并结合态度（attitude）与话语语调（tone）两级层次化分类体系来衡量一致性。核心发现是：显式的社区提示（community prompt）能显著提升宏观层面的社区画像相似度，但在实例级（针对具体事件）预测上收益几乎全部消失；同时不同社区间的提升极不均衡，部分社区变好、部分变差，说明现有社区条件化方法只学到了静态基线画像，无法捕捉真实社区随事件演变的语用行为。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多地被当作计算社会学的代理（proxy）来模拟人类群体，但现有「社会文化对齐」评测普遍把社会身份简化为静态人口学标签或预定义维度，并与聚合的问卷/调查数据对比，这只能刻画一个社区「站在什么立场」（what），却忽略其「如何表达立场」（how）。人类学与社会语言学传统（Geertz 的「thick descriptions」）强调社区是动态的话语空间，群体身份并非固定属性，而是通过语言中介的、依赖具体事件的反应行为不断协商出来的表演。此外，现有评测还缺少可解释、事件依赖（event-contingent）的细粒度语言学测量工具，无法诊断模型是否真正复现了社区的语用策略。
AI.method:
1）数据构建：从 reddit.com 2020 年包含 "coronavirus"/"covid" 的全部帖子出发，仅保留超链接至外部新闻且评论区互动≥10 条的帖子，抽取每帖最多 5 条获赞最高的顶层评论作为真实反应；再经三阶段下采样——社区筛选（活跃度≥9 个月且共享文章数 Top300，取交集得 207 个 subreddit，并人工标注主题域与地理路径）、基于无监督关键短语显著度（结合跨社区频次与覆盖比例的对数加权）筛选新闻、每社区每月最多保留 1 帖——最终得到 2,194 帖、9,947 条反应。
2）语言学 schema：基于言语行为理论（Austin/Searle），在 illocutionary（言外行为）层面定义 reaction tone，并映射到粗粒度态度（立场 support/oppose/neutral + 情感效价 positive/negative/neutral-mixed）。通过人类与多个 SOTA LLM 迭代共创，构建两层层次化语调分类体系：L1 广义语用类别、L2 互斥同义词组，将 362 个语调描述词归并为 141 个 L2 组。
3）标注管线：以 GPT-5 做批量 LLM 标注（先做跨 207 社区的试点与 6 种配置对比，最优配置人工验证接受率 96.6%），同时标注真实反应与模型生成。
4）评测设置：Gemini 2.5 Pro 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 两代同族模型，在 Community-Blind（仅新闻标题正文）、Community-Informed（加入 subreddit 标识）、Community-Informed-CoT（再加社区自述并强制分步推理）三种提示条件下，每对（社区, 帖子）生成 1 条模拟评论。
5）指标：态度层面用 AttHit、RMSE、正/负子集平均误差、Spearman ρ；语调层面用词级与 L2 组级 Exact Match、分布 Jensen-Shannon 散度、词汇/组多样性；宏观层面用社区态度均值 μ 与标准差 σ 的相关性、L2 组熵（组内多样性）、21,321 对社区间 JS 距离相关性（跨社区结构）；并设 Random（362 类均匀）与 Top（最高赞真实反应）基线及四种混合比例构造性能梯度。
AI.result:
1）宏观画像对齐：Community-Blind 表现最差；加入社区上下文后保真度大幅跃升，Gemini 3.1 Pro 提升尤为显著，Gemini 2.5 Pro 则在 CoT 提示下达到峰值。跨社区语调结构（21,321 对社区 JS 距离的 Spearman 相关）两模型均呈上升趋势，组内语调多样性亦明显提高。
2）实例级崩塌：宏观增益在事件层面的预测上基本消失。Gemini 2.5 Pro 的 AttHit 从 Comm-Blind 的 0.63 反而降至 Comm-Informed 0.62、Comm-Inf.-CoT 0.60，Spearman ρ 仅从 0.27 升到 0.30–0.31；Gemini 3.1 Pro 虽从 0.59 升至 0.63/0.62，ρ 从 0.13 升到 0.34/0.31，但 RMSE 并未改善（0.76→0.66→0.67），且 CoT 反而带来轻微回退。说明模型锚定于数据集层面的语调分布与持续存在的负面偏见，而非识别具体的事件触发因素。
3）社区级波动：提示条件化带来的保真度提升在子社区间高度不均，某些 subreddit 的提升被另一些 subreddit 的性能下降所抵消；跨社区语调结构虽有改善，社区层面的不稳定性仍然存在。
4）模型间行为签名差异：Gemini 2.5 Pro 呈现从盲设定到 CoT 的单调上升，需要显式长链式推理才能整合社区上下文；而 Gemini 3.1 Pro 从社区先验即可获益，额外 CoT 反而造成轻微规范性漂移，表明当前对齐策略不足以捕捉在线群体的社会语言学动态。
AI.conclusion: 当前主流的社区条件化（community conditioning）范式只能让模型逼近社区的静态基线画像（粗粒度态度与语调分布），既无法在实例层面捕捉事件依赖的真实反应，也不保证社区间收益的公平与稳定；不同前沿模型在是否需要显式语用推理上表现出不同的行为签名，说明现有对齐策略（包括 CoT）并不足以建模在线群体的动态语用实践。因此，CARE 被定位为社区感知社会模拟的必要诊断工具：评估社会文化对齐应从静态身份标签转向反应中心的、事件依赖的细粒度语用测量，并同时在宏观与微观、群体与子社区多个粒度上报告结果，避免聚合分布掩盖真实失效。

title: Detect by Yourself: Self-Designing Agentic Workflows for Few-Shot Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify anomaly nodes in attributed graphs and plays an important role in real-world applications. However, existing graph anomaly detection methods still face two key challenges: 1) fixed pipelines, which restrict their adaptability across different graph tasks under limited supervision; 2) weak evidence, which prevents them from explicitly incorporating contextual and structural anomaly signals into the detection process. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, self-designing agentic workflows for few-shot graph anomaly detection (SignGAD). Specifically, we propose a novel paradigm that reformulates graph anomaly detection task from training a fixed anomaly detector to designing task-conditioned detection workflows. By constructing detection workflows, SignGAD selects suitable graph encodings and detector designs to exploit task-specific anomaly evidence. Meanwhile, we introduce a guarded final refit strategy to refine the selected workflow by calibrating refit acceptance, enhancing reliability under limited supervision. Extensive experiments conducted on several real-world datasets demonstrate that SignGAD achieves strong performance against state-of-the-art methods, highlighting its effectiveness on graph anomaly detection tasks.

AI.tldr: SignGAD 将图异常检测(GAD)从"训练固定检测器"范式重构为"设计任务条件化检测工作流"范式：由 LLM 智能体依据文本任务描述与图统计信息生成结构化任务描述符，构造候选工作流空间 Ω(C)(图拓扑 + 异常证据函数集 + 检测器族)，通过轻量级证据图编码显式暴露上下文与结构异常信号，再从工作流检测器库实例化线性/非线性/堆叠/关系感知检测器，用验证集阈值校准 + AUC/F1-Macro 平衡准则 + 复杂度惩罚选择最优工作流，最后以"守卫式最终重拟合"用部分验证标签安全地重训检测器。四个真实数据集上以 1% 标注率取得 SOTA 表现并大幅降低运行时间。
AI.motivation: 现有图异常检测方法存在两大局限:1)固定流水线(fixed pipelines)——图处理策略与检测器设计在任务条件未知时预先设定,任务自适应性差,在极少标注(1%)时无法靠少量标签纠正不合适的流程,性能显著退化;2)弱证据(weak evidence)——图上下文中蕴含的异常线索多被吸收进潜在表示,而未被组织成显式的检测证据,检测器难以在标注稀缺时访问可靠的任务特异性证据。同时,真实图异常稀缺且标注昂贵,监督信号受限,而 agentic workflow design(以 LLM 为高层规划器组织工具调用流程)在科学发现与 ML 自动化中已显示潜力,但尚未被引入 GAD 领域。
AI.method: 1) 任务条件化工作流构造:由 LLM 规划器 Π_LLM 将文本任务描述 D_text、图统计 Stat(G) 与少量标注集 V_tr 归纳为结构化任务描述符 C;Plan(Ω_0;C) 生成候选工作流空间 Ω(C),每条工作流 ω=(g,T,f_θ,τ) 含图拓扑(基础邻接 A^(0) 或多关系融合 A^fused=𝕀(ΣA^(r)>0))、证据函数集 T、检测器族与决策规则。2) 证据图编码:在选定拓扑 g 下做行归一化聚合得 1 阶/2 阶邻域表示,拼接原始属性、log(1+度)、邻域表示及属性-邻域/一阶-二阶绝对差构成上下文编码 φ^g_i;证据函数(度异常 z-score、邻居特征偏差、特征平滑度、特征重构残差 SVD、关系度数剖面、关系不一致)输出归一化标量证据 η_i,与 φ^g 拼成 z^ω_i。3) 工作流检测器库:类平衡逻辑回归(线性)、树集成(非线性)、多基检测器堆叠特征 + 元检测器,多关系图额外引入关系级投影特征与关系专属检测器输出,组成 ξ^ω_i。4) 验证工作流搜索:在候选阈值集上最大化验证 F1-Macro 选阈值,同时计算 AUC(A_ω)与 F1-Macro(F_ω),以 [min(A,F), αA+(1−α)F, −Ω_c(ω)] 三元组词典序选择工作流(α=0.5)。5) 守卫式最终重拟合:将验证集划分为重拟合子集与校准子集,重拟合检测器仅当在校准集上 (AUC, F1-Macro) 四位取整后按词典序不劣于原检测器时才被接受,否则回退原检测器。
AI.result: 在 Amazon、YelpChi、T-Finance、T-Social 四个真实数据集(1% 训练比例,10 次运行)上与 18 个基线比较,SignGAD 在 8 个评测项中的 7 项取得第一:AUC 分别为 97.41/92.68/96.79/98.37,F1-Macro 为 91.17/81.55/90.42/93.72,显著优于 ConsisGAD、SpaceGNN、TAQ-GAD 等强基线。在 3%/5%/10% 监督下优势保持(AUC 全项最优)。LLM 变体实验中 GPT-4.1 最佳、GPT-3.5 次之、LLaMA3-8B 最差,但各变体均具竞争力,说明方法不绑定特定骨干。消融显示移除任一组件均导致性能下降,其中 w/o Refit 降幅最大。敏感性分析表明证据函数数 K=4 最优(过多带来冗余噪声),候选工作流数 N_ω=20 达到饱和,验证平衡系数 α=0.5 最优。效率方面 SignGAD 仅需数分钟(T-Social 为 9.98 分钟),而最强基线超过 250 分钟;可视化显示异常节点形成紧凑簇并与正常节点清晰分离;证据选择频率显示各数据集依赖不同证据模式(邻居特征偏差最常被选)。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出 SignGAD,首个将图异常检测重构为任务条件化工作流级设计的 agentic 框架。实验表明通过让 LLM 智能体根据任务语义与图结构统计自动选择图编码方式、显式异常证据与检测器归纳偏置,并辅以验证集校准与守卫式重拟合,可在极少监督下同时获得最优的排序质量与二分类质量,并大幅降低检测成本,验证了"工作流级定制"对少样本 GAD 的必要性与可行性。局限与未来方向可围绕 LLM 规划稳定性与成本、工作流搜索开销、更多图模态与跨任务迁移展开。

title: The Energy Blind Spot: NVIDIA's Flagship Edge AI Hardware Cannot Support Process-Level Energy Attribution
summary: Agentic AI workloads - where a single user goal triggers multi-step orchestration, tool calls, retries, and failure recovery - are being targeted for edge deployment, with NVIDIA, Dell, HP, ASUS, MSI, Acer, and Gigabyte all shipping GB10-based desktop AI systems in 2026. We recently demonstrated that orchestration structure dominates agentic energy cost, with workflows consuming 4.33x more energy per successful goal than linear baselines and OOI reaching 7.63x for multi-step reasoning tasks. Separately, Rajat et al. show that CPU-side processing accounts for up to 90.6% of total latency and 44% of total dynamic energy in agentic workloads. We report a systematic energy-observability audit of the ASUS Ascent GX10 (GB10 SoC) and find that the platform exposes no CPU energy counter, no INA power-rail monitor, no IPMI/BMC, and no SCMI powercap protocol through any supported software interface. The only on-device energy telemetry is instantaneous GPU power via NVML. We further discover that the MediaTek firmware already computes per-rail energy internally via an undocumented ACPI interface (SPBM), but NVIDIA states there are "no plans to expose CPU rail information." On-device per-process energy attribution - as performed on x86 via RAPL - is therefore not reproducible on this platform through supported interfaces. We formalize a hardware requirements specification for energy-attributed AI, propose an interim calibration bridge using external DC metering combined with GPU subtraction, and identify a standards-track path via SCMI powercap. Our findings motivate the low-carbon computing community to demand energy observability as a first-class hardware requirement.

AI.tldr: 本文对 NVIDIA GB10 Grace Blackwell SoC（ASUS Ascent GX10、Acer Veriton GN100）进行了系统的能量可观测性审计，发现该平台无法通过任何受支持的软件接口实现类似 x86 RAPL 的进程级能量归因：既无 CPU 能量计数器、无 INA 电源轨监控、无 IPMI/BMC，也无 SCMI powercap 协议，唯一能量相关遥测是 NVML 的瞬时 GPU 功率。作者进一步发现 MediaTek 固件内部已通过未公开的 ACPI 接口（SPBM，NVDA8800:00）计算各电源轨能量累加器（约 100 ms 刷新），但 NVIDIA 明确表示"无计划暴露 CPU 轨信息"。论文提出硬件需求规范、外部 DC 电表校准桥（E_cpu+sys = E_total − E_gpu）与基于 SCMI powercap 的标准路径，并呼吁将能量可观测性作为一级硬件需求。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI 工作负载（多步编排、工具调用、重试与失败恢复）正快速从云端迁移到边缘设备，NVIDIA GB10 SoC 已被七家 OEM 用于 2026 年的桌面 AI 系统。此前作者的工作表明"编排结构主导 agentic 能量成本"（每成功目标能耗为线性基线的 4.33 倍，多步推理任务 OOI 达 7.63 倍），而该结论的测量基础是 Intel RAPL 提供的进程级能量归因。Raj 等人进一步显示 CPU 侧处理占 agentic 总延迟最高 90.6%、占总动态能量 44%，即主导开销恰好落在无测量的 CPU 域。同时 EU AI Act 附录 XI 与加州 SB 253 要求可复现的能耗计量，AI 推理总用电量预计从 2025 年 15 TWh 增至 2030 年 347 TWh，而更廉价的推理反而因反弹效应催生更多 agentic 部署。核心问题即：NVIDIA 边缘 AI 硬件能否复现 x86 上的能量测量？
AI.method: 在 ASUS Ascent GX10（内核 6.17.0-1018-nvidia，Ubuntu 24.04.4，aarch64；10×Cortex-X925 + 10×Cortex-A725 经 NVLink-C2C 连 Blackwell GPU，128 GB LPDDR5X）上穷举探测七类能量测量接口：ARM SCMI powercap/sensor、ARM PMU 能量事件、INA3221/INA226（I2C 扫描）、IPMI/BMC、hwmon energy/power、电源子系统、NVML。审计以 root 枚举 sysfs 并运行 perf list / nvidia-smi / find /sys。随后对比 NVIDIA 自家 Jetson Orin（板载三颗 TI INA3221）与 x86 RAPL 作为参照。通过 find /sys/bus/acpi/devices 确认 NVDA8800:00（_SB_.MTEL）存在，结合社区 spark_hwmon 驱动的逆向结果分析 SPBM 共享内存区（~100 ms 更新，含各轨毫瓦功率、毫焦耳累计能量、P/E 核簇、GPU、SoC 总封装及分区温度）。用 perf stat 采集 5 秒全系统样本获得双簇 PMUv3 性能计数（X925：332M cycles/61M instr/IPC 0.18/213M 前端停顿/3.9M L3 refill；A725：174M/19M/IPC 0.11/128M/2.4M），并用 nvidia-smi/NVML 读取 GPU 功率与时钟。在 Acer Veriton GN100（内核 6.17.0-1021-nvidia）上做跨 OEM 验证：spark_hwmon 成功绑定 NVDA8800:00（45/45 DSM 偏移解析），SPBM 映射到不重叠区域 0x1c238000，MTKW9000 内存冲突为板级特有问题；DCGM field 156 与 field 155 独立交叉验证。
AI.result: 审计结果：GX10 上 SCMI 总线已注册且活跃，加载 scmi-clocks、scmi-regulator、scmi-mpam-driver、scmi-imx-bbm-key，但无 scmi-powercap 与 scmi-sensor，注册 SCMI 设备数为零——即固件实现了 SCMI 却选择性不暴露 powercap/sensor；ARM PMU 能量事件为零（仅有 idle/频率 tracepoint）；六条 I2C 总线 i2cdetect 全空，无 INA 器件；/dev/ipmi0 不存在；hwmon 仅暴露温度（acpitz、nvme、mt7925），无 energy_uj/power*_input；电源子系统为空；NVML 是全平台唯一能量相关接口（GPU 平均 3.84 W，功率上限与显存功率均 N/A）。因此 RAPL 三层归因中 Layer 1（原始 E_pkg）在 CPU 域不存在，Layer 2 基线扣减与 Layer 3 CPU 比例缩放均无法计算（ARM 的 f_cpu 可从 /proc/{pid}/stat 获得但缺少能量分母）。SPBM 发现表明固件内部已计算 14 路功率通道与 4 个累计能量累加器（含 P 核簇、E 核簇、GPU、SoC 总封装），证明缺口源于产品优先级而非硅片限制：DVFS 需 PMIC 实时电流采样，Jetson Orin 有 INA3221 可提供逐轨能量而更昂贵的 GB10 遥测严格更少；仅需固件更新（硬件方案 INA3221 约 2.5 美元/板）。同时平台非能量遥测丰富：ARMv8 PMUv3 70+ 事件、双簇 338 MHz–3.9 GHz DVFS 六档 governor、4 种 LPI 空闲态、7 个 ACPI 热区（54.7–55.8 °C）、GPU 利用率/时钟 208–3003 MHz；但缺少能量基准使得 Walker 等人式 ARM 功耗模型无法完成 per-SoC 校准，X925 每周期能耗是 A725 的 2 倍还是 5 倍不可测。跨 OEM 验证表明 GN100 上 SPBM 能量累加器可用，MTKW9000 冲突为板级特有，证实结论可推广。
AI.conclusion: 该缺口是系统性而非单一产品问题：Apple M 系列、Qualcomm Snapdragon、Ampere Altra 同样在固件内部做能量监控却不下发到用户态，属 ARM 生态普遍模式。GB10 的能量不可观测性形成"边缘悖论"——以能效为卖点的边缘硬件恰恰取消了验证节能的测量基础设施；组织将 agentic 工作负载从云端（按机架/服务器/VM 计费）迁移到 GB10 后会失去对主导成本的 CPU 编排开销的全部直接可见性。论文提出四项硬件要求：用户态可读、读延迟 <1 ms、分辨率 ≤1 mJ 的逐电源域累计能量计数器；足以区分 CPU/GPU/DRAM/IO 的域粒度；单调递增计数器与明确溢出语义。据此分级：x86 RAPL 与 Jetson Orin + INA3221 为 MEASURED，GB10 与 Apple/Qualcomm 为 LIMITED。补救路径清晰可执行：短期用外部 DC 电表（Monsoon HV、Qoitech Otii，≥1 kHz 采样）+ NVML GPU 功率构成两通道分解，兼顾桥接校准与首次 ARM 边缘编排能耗实证；长期由 NVIDIA/MediaTek 固件启用 SCMI Powercap（CPU 簇/GPU/DRAM/SoC 总封装域、微焦耳累计读数、可配置 MAI、功率上限读写），配合 2026 年 2 月 Radford 的 MAI 补丁与 SCMIv4.0 扩展，使 GB10 成为首个具备研究级能量归因的 ARM 桌面 AI 平台。作者还建议 ML.ENERGY、Zeus 等基准在缺少真实计数器时显式标记缺口而非静默回退到 TDP 估计。局限包括仅覆盖两台 GB10 机器、未测 DGX Spark、I2C 扫描结果具板级特异性、SCMI 结论仅对特定固件版本成立、社区 spark_hwmon 使用未文档化接口与占位 UUID，NVIDIA 明确不支持，不能作为可复现研究基础设施的基础。

title: Decoupled Intelligence: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Controllable Traffic Scenario Generation in SUMO
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) with microscopic traffic simulation offers a promising path toward autonomous urban planning and intelligent transportation analysis. However, existing monolithic agent architectures often struggle with the complexity of end-to-end simulation workflows, leading to reasoning failures, parameter inconsistency, and a lack of systematic state management. This paper proposes a novel multi-agent collaborative framework designed to automate the entire lifecycle of traffic simulation in SUMO (Simulation of Urban Mobility). Our approach decouples the simulation pipeline into specialized roles, including Planner, Builder, Demand, Runner, and Analyst, coordinated by a high-level reasoning engine. We introduce a state-persistent Orchestrator leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to ensure seamless data handover and environmental consistency across distributed agent actions. This architecture enables a robust closed-loop refinement process, where simulation outcomes are iteratively analyzed and optimized to satisfy user-defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Experimental results through role ablation studies demonstrate that the proposed multi-agent framework significantly enhances task success rates and parameter accuracy compared to single-agent baselines. Furthermore, case studies on real-world network extraction and traffic optimization highlight the system's capability to bridge the gap between high-level natural language intent and low-level simulation execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于 Planner-Worker 架构的多智能体 LLM 框架，将 SUMO 微观交通仿真的完整生命周期（网络提取→网络修改→需求生成→仿真执行→KPI 分析）解耦为五个专职角色，并由基于 MCP 的状态持久化 Orchestrator 统一调度，配合双层闭环反思机制实现自主错误修复与 KPI 驱动优化。
AI.motivation: SUMO 是 ITS 领域主流的微观交通仿真平台，但其工作流碎片化、技术门槛高（OSM/GIS 数据提取、网络拓扑精修、路由与流量文件生成、XML 配置），要求大量 SUMO 专有知识与编程能力，阻碍规划者快速原型验证。已有基于 LLM 的自动化尝试（ChatSUMO、TrafficGPT、AgentSUMO、SUMO-MCP 等）多采用单体式智能体，在长链条、多步骤任务中出现推理漂移、参数遗忘、文件路径幻觉与状态不一致等失效模式，亟需结构化的多智能体解耦与显式状态管理方案。
AI.method: 提出 Decoupled Multi-Agent Orchestration 架构。（1）层次化任务分解：高层 Planner 将自然语言目标 𝒢 分解为有序执行图，每个步骤分配专属 worker 角色与严格的输入—输出参数契约（如 Builder 需 city_name/distance_miles/volume，Demand 需 from_edge/to_edge/vph 或 flows，Analyst 需 metric）；（2）状态持久化 Orchestrator：基于 Model Context Protocol 的显式 artifact 上下文仓库，统一管理 .net.xml、.rou.xml、.sumocfg 等产物的生命周期、依赖完整性（拓扑就绪→需求→配置）与确定性交接，消除路径幻觉；（3）双层闭环反思（Algorithm 1）：Level 1 执行错误修复——捕获终端错误、注入全局上下文并递归重规划；Level 2 KPI 优化反馈——Analyst 从 tripinfo.xml/summary.xml 提取行程时间、均值速度、等待时间、CO₂ 等指标，违反 KPI 约束时以语言化反馈驱动 Planner 迭代精修；（4）五个专职角色：Network Builder（netconvert/OSMWebWizard 生成 .net.xml）、Network Modifier（netedit/XML 脚本做删边、车道封闭、TLS 优化，必须先于需求生成）、Demand Engineer（randomTrips.py 或 OD 路由生成 .rou.xml）、Simulation Runner（生成 .sumocfg，选择 headless sumo 或 sumo-gui）、KPI Analyst（解析输出并语言化反馈）；（5）角色采用限定工具集与定制系统提示，输出严格遵守 JSON schema。实验：SUMO 1.21.0 + Qwen3-30B-Coder，ReAct 单体基线对照，30 个 L1/L2/L3 复杂度任务基准，指标为 SR、Avg Tokens、TTI；并做修复次数 0/1/2 的闭环消融。
AI.result: 消融实验（Table I）：L1 单体 100% SR vs 多智能体 90%（存在轻微退化）；L2 两者均 100%；L3 单体降至 70%（失败主因为 Path Reference Errors 与 Reasoning Drift），多智能体达 90%。效率优势显著：多智能体 Avg Tokens 约降 50%（如 L3 11404.7→6028.7），TTI 大幅缩短（L3 41.4s→8.3s，约 5 倍加速；L1 19.8→6.2s，L2 22.7→7.3s）。闭环自主性实验（Table II）：L2/L3 开环 SR 仅 30%，一次修复提升至 50%（+20 个百分点），两次修复持平，表明多数可恢复错误在首轮反思中解决；代价是 token 消耗上升（L3 3981.6→6609.9→9214.1），并在 L1 出现"过度思考"现象——Analyst 将良性零车辆警告误判为致命错误，SR 一度从 90% 降至 80%，第二次修复后恢复。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式 Planner-Worker 多智能体框架有效缓解了单体 LLM 在长链条 SUMO 任务中的推理漂移：L3 复杂度下 SR 达 90%、token 消耗减半、TTI 提升约 5 倍（41.4s→8.3s）；双层反思机制在最少修复次数下将闭环成功率由 30% 提升至 50%，证明 KPI 驱动自主优化可行，为全自动"城市移动性实验室"奠定基础。局限与展望：框架在工具接口层面模型无关，但实际可靠性依赖骨干模型生成 schema 合规 JSON 与遵守角色约束的能力，较弱或未经指令微调的模型更易违反契约，需引入约束解码或外部 JSON 校验；规划提示存在初始 token 开销；闭环调试在简单任务上存在误判与 token 成本权衡；未来将扩展至城市级生成式世界模型与多模态基础模型整合，并以 R1 式强化微调优化 Planner 的零样本分解能力。基准任务、提示模板与评测脚本将开源，系统代码经内部评审后发布。

title: A Systematic Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Language Models for Space Operations
summary: The rapid expansion of space activities has led to an unprecedented accumulation of technical documentation, operational guidelines, and scientific literature, creating challenges for timely decision-making in space operations. Effective management in space operations requires tools capable of efficiently processing vast and heterogeneous information sources. This paper systematically evaluates the performance of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, combining Large Language Models (LLMs) with information retrieval techniques for extracting and synthesizing actionable knowledge from domain-specific documents. We compare various retrieval strategies, embedding models, and LLM answers to assess their impact on information accuracy, relevance, and reliability. Our results demonstrate that RAG pipelines can significantly enhance knowledge access, reduce uncertainty, and support decision-making in complex space operations.

AI.tldr: 本文面向航天运行（space operations）场景，系统评测了 RAG（检索增强生成）流水线中检索器、重排器与生成器的表现：以 8 个主流嵌入模型 + BM25 作检索器、三款开源重排器集成充当"伪真值"、512 与 2000 token 两种切块粒度，并在 ESA SpaceQA（60 题）上评估 Llama 3 8B 的回答质量。结论是：加入重排器能显著提升上下文相关性，"512 token 短块 + 重排"是最佳组合；带检索上下文的答案准确率为 56/60，去掉上下文后骤降至 3/60，表明 RAG 对航天任务中的知识获取与决策支持具有实质价值。
AI.motivation: 航天任务数量与复杂度激增，工程师与操作人员需处理大量且异构的文档（工程分析、操作规程、法规、科学文献，如 200–300 页的 Concurrent Design Facility 报告、德国宇航中心 GSOC 的海量技术数据），当前依赖人工查阅与遗留工具链，效率低、难以扩展、易出错且认知负担重。同时航天数据高度敏感，不适合云端处理，因此需要可离线/封闭部署的开源模型与框架。已有工作（如 Belo et al.）仅初步比较两种检索模型并做了定性分析，缺少对检索器、重排器、切块策略与答案质量的系统量化。
AI.method: 1) 上下文相关性数据集：在前人空间碎片减缓文献合成 QA 基础上补充负样本，采用两种策略——随机负采样（用 BGE-M3 打分取最不相关的 k 条域内片段）与文档内负采样（取自同一源文档的更难负例）。2) 重排器验证：选用 BGE-M3 reranker、GTE-reranker-base、Jina-reranker-v2，在 Golden-Offset/Golden-Aligned 两个子集上以 F1 与 Accuracy 评估，并用三者集成以规避架构/训练数据带来的偏置。3) 检索评测：从 MMTEB 榜单选取 8 个 <2B 参数的开源嵌入模型 + BM25，每查询取 Top-50；以 BM25 Top-100 经重排后的排序作为伪真值，计算 Recall、Precision、NDCG、Kendall Tau 四个指标并在多个 top-k 下比较，分别在 2000 与 512 token 切块下进行；并用 LLM 评审（Llama 3.3 70B）对检索/重排结果按 0–3 级打相关性分，统计 Top-3/5/7/10 分布。4) 生成评测：在 ESA SpaceQA（60 条问答三元组）上用 Llama 3 8B 生成，注入 4 条随机域内噪声片段构造"噪声上下文"，测量答案准确率、忠实性、相关性、噪声鲁棒性（由 LLaMA 3.3 70B 与 Qwen 2.5 72B 集成评审，1–5 分），并逐例分析错误答案。

AI.conclusion: 当前开源模型已具备在受控航天运行场景中部署的潜力：RAG 显著增强知识访问、降低不确定性并支撑复杂决策；检索器是决定系统性能的关键环节（对含重排的管线应优先高召回、低延迟的检索器如 BM25，仅用检索器时则应重视 NDCG，如 BGE-M3 或 Qwen2）；重排器对提升上下文相关性收益明显，短片段（≤512 token）更优。作者同时指出结论为"指示性"而非确定性：SpaceQA 仅 60 题、文档内负例偏易、以重排器作真值代理、LLM 评审与人类判断的一致性仍是开放问题；后续可通过更难的负例、LLM 打分或人工评审、增广数据集及更丰富的任务元数据来改进。

title: LLM-assisted sentiment analysis for integrated computational and qualitative mixed methods education research: A case study of students' written reflection assignments
summary: Written reflection assignments give students valuable opportunities for critical self-assessment, meaning making, and learning processing. Additionally, such reflections provide rich data for qualitative education research. However, qualitative data can be time-consuming to analyze. It is even more time-intensive to qualitatively compare findings between different groups of participants, usually limiting comparison to, at most, one variable (e.g., binary gender). Large language models (LLMs) have recently begun to be critically evaluated for use as qualitative research assistants. Using a longitudinal case of written student reflections (n=151) from a study abroad program, we investigate how LLM-assisted sentiment analysis can enable longitudinal mixed-methods research combining computational and thematic analyses. First, statistical testing is used to quantitatively compare sentiment differences according to seven different student identity/lived experience variables. Then, these results inform qualitative data analysis to investigate the reasons underlying these differences. For the case of undergraduate students studying abroad, we found that prior experience living abroad was the only personal variable impacting students' sentiments of their verbal language and communication behaviors. This workflow has implications for how qualitative researchers can more easily probe multiple variables when comparing participants from different demographic groups.

AI.tldr: 本文利用LLM辅助的情感分析，对151份海外学习项目学生书面反思文本进行纵向混合方法研究：先用统计检验比较7个身份/生活经历变量对情感的影响差异，再以质性主题分析解释差异成因。发现"此前有海外居住经验"是唯一影响学生对口语与沟通行为情感的个体变量，为定性研究者低成本考察多变量组间比较提供了工作流。
AI.motivation: 书面反思作业兼具教学价值（批判性自我评估、意义建构、学习过程加工）与研究价值（为定性教育研究提供丰富数据）。但定性数据分析耗时，更耗时的是跨参与者群体进行定性比较，实践中通常最多只能考察一个变量（如二元性别）。随着LLM开始被批判性地评估为定性研究助手，本文试图检验LLM辅助的情感分析能否把纵向质性研究与多变量计算分析结合起来，从而突破"单一变量比较"的限制。
AI.method: 采用纵向案例研究设计，样本为某海外学习（study abroad）项目的151份本科生书面反思。以LLM（如ChatGPT类模型）辅助执行情感分析：从文本中提取/判断学生对其口语与沟通行为的情感倾向并赋予评分，输出结构化情感数据。随后以统计检验（如t检验/非参数检验）定量比较依据7个学生身份与生活经历变量（如性别、年龄、专业、年级、族裔背景、是否曾有海外居住经历等）分组的情感差异；再将统计结果作为质性取样与编码的引导，深入分析导致差异的主题与机制，形成"计算发现→质性解释"的顺序混合方法工作流。
AI.result: 在本科海外学习情境下，7个变量中仅"此前是否有海外居住经验"对学生的口语与沟通行为情感具有显著影响。该变量可作为质性主题分析的切入点，用于解释具有/不具有海外生活经验的学生在语言适应、自信与沟通策略上的感受差异；其余变量（性别等）未显示显著情感差异，说明单一变量（如二元性别）比较可能掩盖更有意义的组间差异。同时验证了LLM情感分析在规模化编码长篇反思文本中的可行性与效率优势。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助的情感分析可作为定量与定性之间的桥梁，使质性研究者能够同时考察多个参与者群体变量，而不再局限于单一（如二元性别）比较。这一"统计检验驱动质性追问"的混合方法工作流对教育及其他质性研究领域具有方法论启示，可降低多变量组间比较的时间成本并提升分析深度。

title: Do LLMs Favor Their Providers? Measuring Vertical Integration Bias in Code Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an integral part of software development, especially with the advent of agentic capabilities. Yet, many frontier LLMs are affiliated with specific providers. This raises the question of whether generated code favors the provider's own ecosystem over comparable alternatives, potentially constraining developers' choices and increasing dependence on a single provider. We define this behavior as Vertical Integration Bias (VIB) and introduce \textsc{VIBench}, a benchmark for measuring VIB in direct and agentic code generation across $20$ provider-selectable software-integration scenarios. Evaluating $10$ frontier provider-affiliated models against $3$ non-affiliated controls, we find positive VIB in direct generation, with six of ten affiliated models showing statistically significant effects up to $+18.8$ percentage points (pp). Agentic workflows further amplify VIB, reaching $+39.2$ pp. Moreover, early affiliated-ecosystem choices in agentic workflows can persist into conceptually decoupled downstream files, with persistence as high as $90.3\%$. These findings underscore the need to measure and account for VIB in code generation, especially as agentic capabilities become more prevalent.

title: You Are in Control of Your State: Why Human Outcomes Are Controllable Through Causal State Intervention
comment: 20 pages, 12 figures, 37 references. Companion to a prior SSRN preprint on causal architecture for human modelling
summary:
A central puzzle for the behavioural sciences and for human-facing artificial intelligence is the persistence of within-person variability. The same individual, presented with the same observable input, produces different outcomes on different occasions, and different individuals produce divergent outcomes that no observable covariate fully predicts. We argue that this variability belongs in the dynamic latent state of the person, and that human outcomes are controllable in a precise and operational sense through interventions that target the state and its weighting at the moment a decision is being formed.
  We define a state as the time-indexed weighting vector over the dimensions that govern how an individual's biology, physiology, and neuropsychology process the next event into a decision and an outcome. The relationship between state, decision, and outcome is causal rather than correlational. The weighting vector is dynamic at sub-daily timescales. The conscious channel through which outcomes are reportable is a narrow attentional bottleneck whose contents are themselves state-dependent. Taken together, these claims imply that the outcome of a given event is controllable, conditionally, on the state-trajectory at the time of intervention.
  We motivate the framework with six strands of established evidence (causal inference, predictive processing, allostasis, attentional bottleneck, chronobiology, computational psychiatry) and a 24-month observational base from a deployed behavioural platform spanning more than 200,000 consented users across four occupational personas (research period 2023 to 2026). We derive seven testable predictions, list six operational requirements for state-aware systems, and discuss implications for digital health, education, AI personalisation, and personal agency.

title: EvoSpec: Evolving Speculative Decoding via Real-Time Vocabulary and Parameter AdaptationTarget
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model inference via a draft-then-verify paradigm, yet the output projection layer becomes a bottleneck as vocabulary sizes scale. While existing static pruning methods effectively reduce this overhead, they suffer from precipitous drops in acceptance rate in specialized domains or topic-switching scenarios due to their inability to capture dynamic distribution shifts. To address this, we introduce EvoSpec, a framework that enables real-time evolution of the draft model through dynamic vocabulary and parameter adaptation. Unlike static or purely retrieval-based approaches, EvoSpec employs a context-aware mechanism that retrieves critical long-tail tokens via efficient semantic and statistical indexing. Furthermore, we propose a lightweight online alignment strategy utilizing curriculum learning to continually minimize the distributional gap between the draft and target models. Extensive evaluations across specialized domains (coding, law, and medicine) confirm that EvoSpec overcomes the limitations of static baselines. On EAGLE-3, it achieves a 1.13x speedup in these settings over the state-of-the-art static baseline FR-Spec, with 27\% lower memory overhead than standard online adaptation.

title: HEAL: Resilient and Self-* Hub-based Learning
summary: Decentralized learning enhances privacy, scalability, and fault tolerance by distributing data and computation across nodes. A popular approach is Federated learning, which relies on a central aggregator, yet faces challenges such as server vulnerabilities, scalability issues, privacy risks and most importantly, the single point of failure. Alternatively Gossip Learning and Epidemic Learning offer fully decentralization through peer-to-peer exchanges of model updates, ensuring robustness and privacy, at the price of slower model convergence. In this work, we introduce a novel decentralized learning framework called HEAL. HEAL is the first cross-layer decentralized learning framework that exploits an optimized self-organizing and self-healing underlying P2P overlay combining the strengths of Federated Learning, Gossip and Epidemic Learning. Leveraging the recently proposed Elevator algorithm, HEAL promotes dynamically chosen nodes to act as aggregators. Through simulations, we demonstrate that HEAL has similar performances to that of Federated Learning in crash-free settings, while being fully decentralized and fault-tolerant. In crash and churn prone environments HEAL outperforms Gossip and Epidemic Learning.

title: Heterogeneous Parallelism for Multimodal Large Language Model Training
summary: Foundation model training is becoming multimodal, from post-training pipelines to large-scale pretraining. As modality coverage broadens, context windows grow, and encoder LLM scales diverge, a single LLM-centric TP/CP/PP/DP/EP layout increasingly limits throughput. This coupling forces encoders to inherit LLM-driven sharding and placement choices that can add communication, limit encoder parallelism, or constrain the LLM schedule; the mismatch is most pronounced at long contexts, where LLM context parallelism is needed for the fused multimodal sequence but encoder inputs remain bounded. We present heterogeneous parallelism for multimodal large language model training, an abstraction that lets modules in one end-to-end graph use independent layouts and rank placements, supporting colocated execution on shared GPUs and non-colocated execution on disjoint rank sets. The key challenge is preserving boundary tensor semantics across independent layouts: forward activations must be materialized for the destination layout, while backward gradients must be routed back to the source layout. We address this with boundary communicators that implement forward and backward layout transforms, plus scheduling extensions for both placement modes. We evaluate optimized homogeneous, colocated heterogeneous, and non-colocated heterogeneous configurations across multimodal workloads and GPU scales to characterize when added layout and placement freedom exposes a better operating point. Across this sweep, colocated heterogeneity improves TFLOPS/GPU by up to 49.3%, while non-colocated heterogeneity improves aggregate token throughput by up to 13.0% and TFLOPS/GPU by up to 9.6%. We validate loss convergence parity against homogeneous baselines and release the system as an open-source Megatron-LM extension.

title: Long Live the Librarian! A Persistent Search Sub-Agent for Energy-Efficient Multi-Agent Software Engineering Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) have substantially advanced autonomous software engineering (SWE), but their growing inference energy demands raise sustainability concerns. In this paper, we demonstrate that this cost is concentrated in an overlooked source: redundant output tokens generated across agents. Two empirical findings ground this claim. First, our per-token energy attribution for MAS reveals a sharp asymmetry: an output token consumes 30 to 1,000 times more energy than an input or cached token. Second, MAS inflate per-episode output because agents repeatedly re-explore overlapping repository regions. To address this inefficiency, we propose Librarian, a persistent search sub-agent that tracks repository-search history and suppresses redundant exploration actions across agents. By returning short references to file regions instead of full file excerpts, Librarian further reduces output-token volume. On SWE-Bench Verified, Librarian reduces per-episode GPU energy consumption of existing multi-agent SWE systems by up to 25% while preserving task performance.

title: RAGe: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation Framework
summary: Deploying Large Language Model (LLM) applications, particularly those relying on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), remains challenging due to high computational demands, outdated knowledge bases, and the need to manually select optimal pipeline components. In this work, we propose a modular framework for benchmarking and guiding the efficient development of RAG applications by focusing on resource telemetry and component recommendation, suggesting the best components for a domain-specific dataset. title: Smaller, Younger, and More Impactful: How AI-Assisted Writing Transforms Research Teams
summary: The era of Big Science has long been defined by increasingly large and specialized research teams pushing the frontiers of knowledge. However, recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), are beginning to reshape academic writing and scientific research, potentially disrupting the longstanding trend toward ever-larger teams and transforming other dimensions of research team structure. Drawing on 147,074 full-text publications from the PLoS family and the Nature portfolio since 2020, we examined whether and how AI-assisted writing influences team structure and team outcomes in science. Using multiple methods, including ordinary least square, quantile regression, Poisson regression, logistic regression and propensity score matching, we found that research teams using AI-assisted writing tend to be younger and smaller. Importantly, this shift toward more compact, junior-leaning teams does not come at the expense of scientific impact. On the contrary, we observed a higher probability of research teams that employed AI-assisted writing producing highly impactful publications. These results highlight the significant role of AI-assisted writing in reshaping not only how research is produced, but also how research teams are formed and assembled. Our findings call for policy improvements in research evaluation, funding, and training to address this emerging trend.

summary: This paper reports a deliberately small executable proof for a DAG-TOML contract: six "Hello, world!" implementations in Rust, Go, C, Java, TypeScript, and AWK are linked to one observable-output contract, one implementation DAG, one traceability file, one readiness gate, and one evidence matrix. The contribution is not a benchmark, a claim of general semantic equivalence, or a production assurance system. It is a compact, falsifiable artifact that shows how a contract, implementation graph, traceability chain, and review gate can be checked against executable witnesses.

title: Cyberbullying Governance on Social Media: A Unified Framework from Content Identification to Intervention
summary: The proliferation of social media platforms and online communities has inadvertently catalyzed the spread of cyberbullying, hate speech, and other forms of online toxicity, making the effective governance of such harm a critical societal and computational challenge. While significant strides have been made in automating content moderation, existing research predominantly treats cyberbullying governance as passive, isolated detection at the post level. This reductionist view overlooks the continuous behavioral dynamics of users, the structural diffusion of toxic events, and the critical need for proactive mitigation. To bridge these gaps, this paper proposes a unified full-lifecycle governance framework that shifts the paradigm of cyberbullying governance from isolated static detection toward integrated, continuous, and proactive moderation. Drawing on cyberbullying research and adjacent fields, we systematically synthesize the state-of-the-art literature across four interconnected stages: (1) Content Identification, (2) User and Behavior Modeling, (3) Diffusion Dynamics and Early Warning, and (4) Intervention and Governance. Furthermore, we review available datasets and evaluation practices, and discuss emerging challenges including multimodality, explainability, algorithmic fairness, and the dual-use risks of generative AI, providing a roadmap for future research toward a safer and more resilient digital ecosystem.

title: StoryMI: Steerable Multi-Agent Therapeutic Dialogue Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent dialogue, but prior works lack situational grounding, dynamic strategy control, and evaluation aligned with clinical standards in motivational interviewing (MI). We introduce StoryMI, a multi-LLM agent framework for controllable MI dialogue generation, where questionnaire-based client profiles are expanded into situational stories that provide narrative context for the dialogue. Therapist and client agents generate MI-coded utterances guided by MI codes selected by the interaction agent, while an interaction agent dynamically coordinates exchanges to control MI strategies during a multi-turn conversation. We propose a two-level evaluation protocol: lexical metrics and MI-specific measures of macro-level counseling strategies, alongside LLM-as-judge and human expert assessments. We construct a dataset of 6K simulated MI dialogues grounded in 1K questionnaire-story pairs, covering 12 MI codes and 13 symptom domains, and benchmark six open- and closed-source LLMs. Our results show that situational grounding and macro-level control can improve MI adherence and clinical plausibility, demonstrating the effectiveness of a structured multi-agent workflow for psychotherapy dialogue generation. We provide code and data for reproducibility.

title: Balancing Fidelity and Diversity in Diffusion Models via Symmetric Attention Decomposition: Hopfield Perspective
summary: We characterize the pre-softmax attention matrix $\mathbf{QK^\top}$ in transformers as an associative memory matrix encoding pairwise associations between input features. By decomposing this matrix into its symmetric and skew-symmetric parts, we interpret the symmetric component as governing the structure of the energy landscape, and the skew-symmetric component as driving circulation on that landscape. Leveraging the energy formulation induced by the symmetric component, we derive Hopfield-style stability measures that quantify the stability of retrieved features. We observe meaningful correlations between Hopfield-style stability measures and the fidelity-diversity trade-offs in generation. Finally, we propose a controllable knob to modulate this trade-off by modifying the circulation of the underlying dynamics. Code is available at our GitHub (https://github.com/hyeon-cho/Attention-Symmetric-Decomposition).

title: How Far Can Disaggregation Go? A Design-Space Exploration of Attention-FFN Disaggregation for Efficient MoE LLM Serving
summary: Modern large language model (LLM) inference has progressively disaggregated to keep pace with growing model sizes and tight TTFT and TPOT service-level objectives: from chunked-prefill aggregation, to prefill-decode (P/D) disaggregation, and most recently to operator-level Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD). This trend is especially important for mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, where memory-bound attention, compute-intensive expert FFNs, and MoE dispatch/combine communication create distinct resource demands. AFD further exposes this heterogeneity by placing attention and MoE-FFN execution on separate GPU groups. Each level of disaggregation deepens the scheduling design space across workload characteristics, resource allocation, and interconnect topology, raising the central question: when does each level actually pay off? We systematically characterize this trade-off for MoE inference across realistic workloads spanning input/output sequence lengths, prefix-KV reuse, and per-user latency constraints. Using chunked-prefill and P/D disaggregation as baselines, we study the benefits and limits of AFD at scale through a framework that fuses on-device kernel measurements with high-fidelity network simulation. Under strict TTFT/TPOT SLOs, AFD sustains around 4k tokens/s of system throughput on DeepSeek-V3.2 across chat, coding, and agentic-coding workloads, where non-AFD deployments are infeasible. We distill concrete takeaways for jointly optimizing throughput and interactivity, including how to partition attention and FFN across GPUs as a function of workload and model architecture, providing design principles for current rack- and cluster-scale deployments as well as future disaggregated AI infrastructure.

title: Checking Fact with Better Retrieval: Dynamic Contrastive Learning for Evidence Retrieval
summary: In the field of multimodal fact checking, the accuracy of retrieving evidence from different modalities has a significant impact on the downstream claim verification process. Existing general multimodal retrieval methods are often constructed based on semantics, resulting in the retrieved evidence being similar but not relevant to the claim. This paper proposes a \textbf{D}ynamic \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{C}ontrastive \textbf{L}earning method for evidence \textbf{R}etrieval called DACLR to address these issues. DACLR first uses a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to uniformly convert multimodal evidence and claims into text modalities, and extracts the features of these information at event level. Then, it conducts evidence retrieval through a two-stage retrieval method of recall-rerank. DACLR enhances the model's event perception ability of the retrieval stage by optimizing the contrastive loss and mining hard negative samples. Specifically, DACLR designs three loss functions at two levels (semantic and event) based on the InfoNCE loss.Corresponding to these, three sets of hard negative sample candidates are set up. The model dynamically adjusts the ratio based on the accuracy supervision signal of intra-batch samples, allowing the model to learn the correlation between claims and positive samples at the event level without forgetting the semantic retrieval ability. Extensive comparison and ablation experiments demonstrates the effectiveness of DACLR and its internal optimization methods. Further research also prove the advantages of DACLR in the field of multimodal evidence retrieval.

title: Local Privacy Laws in a Globalized World
comment: Accepted in ACM Conference on Data and Application Security and Privacy (CODASPY) 2026
summary: Personal data has emerged as a highly valuable yet sensitive asset that drives business decisions, enables targeted advertising, and generates substantial revenue for companies, while simultaneously facilitating invasive monitoring of users. In recent years, research on digital privacy violations, including undue access, collection, and sharing of user data, has grown significantly. Much of this research adopts the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) as the primary reference framework. This is reasonable, as GDPR was a pioneering legislation, and many of its stipulations are clear and unambiguous. However, we argue that focusing solely on GDPR (and a small set of other Western regulatory frameworks) ignores privacy-related concerns, attitudes, and problems faced by users from other locales, creating a significant research blind spot. This work systematically normalizes the heterogeneous legal requirements of multiple data protection laws into a unified abstraction aligned with the data lifecycle, which forms the foundation for the implementation of such regulations. We further investigate the implications of these laws on different stakeholders, including users, organizations, and governments. Overall, this work aims to broaden the digital privacy research community's perspective and to serve as a set of guiding principles for developing technological privacy solutions spanning multiple countries.

title: Voluntary Collusion with Secret Tools in Competing LLM Agents
summary: Even when a tool is explicitly described as unfair and harmful to others, ostensibly safety-aligned LLM agents still voluntarily engage in secret collusion whenever doing so confers a strategic advantage. To investigate this phenomenon, we introduce an empirical framework built on two strategic multi-agent environments: Liar's Bar, a competitive deception scenario, and Cleanup, a mixed-motive resource-management scenario, in which agents are offered secret collusion tools that provide significant advantages while clearly disadvantaging the other agents. Across 12 models (at the 7B, 70B, and proprietary scales) and 6 prompt variants, we find that most agents consistently accept these tools and develop collusive strategies, while explicitly acknowledging the unfairness of the tools before accepting. We further show that neither the unfairness labels nor baseline alignment alone reliably deters collusion: only explicit ethical framing reduces adoption and, even then, smaller models remain susceptible. More broadly, our work presents the first systematic investigation of voluntary collusion adoption in LLM-based multi-agent systems, and suggests that preventing such behaviour requires explicit safeguards rather than reliance on general alignment.

title: Debate Helps Weak Judges Reward Stronger Models
summary:
Despite theoretical promise, debate as a scalable oversight protocol has produced mixed empirical results: gains in some settings, and null effects in others, especially when the judge does not have information hidden from it. We study proposer-critic debate in a stronger-debater/weaker-judge setting on programmatically verifiable code and logic tasks. Debate helps the judge over a consultancy baseline when the critic provides a usable advantage: the critic's classification ability must exceed the judge's, and the judge must treat critic speeches as claims to verify rather than testimony to summarize.
  On the three of five pairings where the condition holds, proposer-critic debate's gains are statistically significant over consultancy, and these pairings are the most capable model pairings. On the two non-responder pairings in our set, debate produces null effects, and judge verification rates drop by tens of percentage points once a critic enters the transcript. In these cases the critic's binary-classification ability and the judge's are within noise of each other, and the critic's disagreement is parsed as testimony rather than a claim to check.
  Ablating rebuttal rounds from debate produces no measurable change in judge performance: a single independent critique recovers the bulk of debate's benefit at lower inference cost. These findings suggest a cheaper primitive for training-free scalable oversight in verifiable domains (answer, critique, judge) and a pre-deployment audit (does the critic beat the judge, and will the judge verify it?) that predicts when debate will help.

title: Resource-Constrained Affect Modelling via Variance Regularisation Pruning
comment: This paper has been accepted at the 2026 PErvasive Technologies Related to Assistive Environments (PETRA)
summary: Affective computing systems are increasingly embedded in pervasive and interactive environments, such as adaptive games, assistive technologies, and resource-constrained platforms, where computational efficiency must be balanced with reliability across diverse users. Model pruning offers an effective way to reduce computational demands, yet existing approaches typically optimise for sparsity alone, without accounting for how parameter removal impacts robustness across individuals. In this work, we introduce Variance-Regularised Pruning (VR), a pruning framework that explicitly incorporates cross-participant stability into the sparsification process. Rather than relying solely on average prediction error, VR evaluates each connection based on its joint contribution to both prediction accuracy and variability across users, prioritising parameters that remain reliable under distributional differences. We evaluate the proposed approach on the AGAIN dataset, which includes arousal annotations collected across nine affect-eliciting game environments. Experimental results demonstrate that VR maintains competitive Concordance Correlation Coefficient (CCC) performance even at 80\% sparsity without additional fine-tuning, highlighting its suitability for deployment in real-world, resource-limited affect-aware systems. Overall, the proposed framework supports the development of compact, robust affective models that can operate reliably in real-world interactive environments.

title: Context Features Are Cheap: Rank-Aware Decomposition for Efficient Feature Interaction in Recommender Systems
summary:
Modern industrial recommender systems use a deep ranking model to score N candidates against the same user and context features. Standard implementations broadcast context features early in the forward pass, redundantly computing context-only operations N times per request. We present a rank-aware decomposition applicable to the dominant interaction mechanisms in modern recommender architectures-Factorization Machine (FM) pairwise products, Deep Cross Network (DCNv2) cross layers, self-attention, and fully connected (FC) projection layers-built on a single algebraic principle: any linear or bilinear operation over a rank-partitioned input admits an exact block decomposition that moves context-only computation from once-per-candidate to once-per-request, identity-equivalent to the original model. Closed-form analysis and controlled ablation verify that savings scale quadratically with the number of context features. Applied to a production DLRM-style ranker without any architectural change, the decomposition increases per-pod throughput by 87.5% (a 47% reduction in peak pod count) at identical model predictions.
  The identity-equivalent decomposition applies only at the first layer of cross networks and self-attention, since each layer mixes ranks in its output. To extend savings across depth, we further introduce rDCN, an architectural variant of DCNv2 that maintains rank discipline across depth and matches DCNv2 accuracy within training noise at 67% fewer total FLOPs, and sketch an analogous architectural variant for self-attention.

title: Beyond pass@k: Redundancy-Aware RLVR for Multi-Sample Code Generation
summary: LLMs for code generation are commonly evaluated in repeated-sampling settings using Pass@k, where multiple candidate programs are executed against unit tests under a finite sampling budget. While recent verifier-based reinforcement learning (RLVR) methods improve executable correctness, how these objectives affect redundancy among sampled programs remains poorly understood. In this work, we study implementation-level redundancy in code generation using JPlag, a plagiarism-detection system for code. Across models and benchmarks, we show that correctness-only RLVR often concentrates generations around repeated implementations, whereas Pass@k-aware objectives maintain lower redundancy and improve larger-budget performance. Motivated by these observations, we augment RLVR with direct anti-redundancy rewards based on JPlag similarity. Across 3 models and 3 benchmarks, discouraging near-duplicate generations reliably improves finite-budget executable performance, often matching or outperforming specialized Pass@k-aware objectives.

title: PAST2HARM: A Simple Adaptive Past Tense Attack for Jailbreaking Multimodal AI
summary:
Jailbreak attacks on multimodal AI systems remain underexplored, even though unsafe image generation can have more severe consequences than unsafe text and current defenses are relatively immature. We introduce PAST2HARM, a simple yet effective adaptive jailbreak framework that bypasses refusal training in state of the art multimodal text to image models. Building on prior findings that past tense reformulations can evade safeguards, PAST2HARM systematically exploits this vulnerability in multimodal generative AI.
  We characterize the attack along two dimensions. First, breadth: through temporal deepening, the framework incrementally strengthens historical anchoring and archival cues, eroding refusal boundaries across models with varying alignment strength. Second, depth: via iterative escalation after initial compliance, we probe the upper bound of harmful generation, measuring severity using a scalar severity jailbreak metric evaluated by a language model acting as a judge. We find that mid conversation turns form peak vulnerability windows, where harmfulness increases before plateauing and eventually undergoing semantic inversion.
  We evaluate PAST2HARM on three models Gemini Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, and SD XL achieving attack success rates of 83 percent, 67 percent, and 100 percent in a black box, gradient free setting. Adversarial prompts also transfer across models, with cross model success rates above 50 percent. The attack elicits diverse harmful outputs, including explicit sexual content, political disinformation, historical denial narratives, hate speech, and self harm glorification. We further release a curated benchmark of prompts, reformulations, and outputs as a resource for red teaming and alignment. Our results expose fundamental brittleness in current safeguards and highlight the need for stronger multimodal safety training.

title: Energy-Structured Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
summary: While orthogonal subspace methods try to mitigate task interference in Continual Learning (CL), they often suffer from energy diffusion across the basis, hindering knowledge compaction and exhausting capacity for future tasks. We observe that output feature drift induced by parameter updates is inherently low-rank, and theoretically prove that preserving parameters along the principal directions of this drift minimizes the output reconstruction error. Motivated by this, we propose \textbf{E}nergy-Concentrated and \textbf{E}nergy-Ordered \textbf{Lo}w-\textbf{R}ank \textbf{A}daptation (E$^2$-LoRA). By explicitly ordering and concentrating knowledge into leading ranks, E$^2$-LoRA frees capacity for subsequent tasks. Furthermore, we design a dynamic rank allocation strategy to balance stability and plasticity by jointly optimizing energy retention and model plasticity. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that E$^2$-LoRA achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: SwarmHarness: Skill-Based Task Routing via Decentralized Incentive-Aligned AI Agent Networks
summary: Vast quantities of compute (GPU cycles on personal workstations, idle inference servers, and edge devices between jobs) go unused because no incentive-aligned protocol exists for their owners to share them safely and profitably. Existing approaches either require a trusted central coordinator (cloud marketplaces), demand heavy blockchain infrastructure (Golem, BrokerChain), or lack an incentive layer entirely (BOINC, Petals). We propose SwarmHarness, a decentralised protocol in which HarnessAPI skill nodes self-organise into a compute swarm without any central authority. SwarmHarness has three interlocking components: a SwarmRegistry built on a Distributed Hash Table (DHT) for peer discovery and capability advertisement; a SwarmRouter that dispatches tasks to nodes using a utility function over capability, load, latency, and trust; and SwarmCredit, an incentive mechanism that attributes compute-credit rewards to contributing nodes via a Shapley-value approximation. Nodes earn credits by serving tasks and spend credits to submit them; idle nodes that never contribute drain credits and lose routing priority, creating a self-regulating participation economy. As nodes specialise toward high-reward skills and routing signals act as digital pheromones, the network exhibits emergent collective intelligence analogous to biological swarms. Beyond compute sharing, SwarmHarness is a foundational primitive for autonomous distributed AI agent networks in which agents hire compute, route subtasks, and settle credits without human intermediation.

title: Eliot: Interactively $\underline{E}$xploring Fast-Changing Scientific $\underline{Li}$terature Trends with $\underline{O}$nline Da$\underline{t}$a and Learning
summary: The rapid growth of scientific publishing has made it increasingly difficult to track how fast-moving areas evolve. Search engines and LLM-based assistants retrieve or summarize papers, but often hide how the corpus was selected, organized, or connected to temporal patterns. We present $\texttt{Eliot}$, a publicly deployed interactive system for traceable exploration of evolving scientific literature. Motivated by two studies on Large Language Models (LLMs) and Automated Planning and Scheduling (APS), $\texttt{Eliot}$ generalizes literature-evolution analysis beyond hand-built taxonomies and domain-specific scripts. Given explicit query terms and filters, it retrieves arXiv papers at query time, represents each paper by title and abstract, clusters the corpus into themes, assigns representative keywords, and visualizes each cluster's publication-year distribution. We evaluate $\texttt{Eliot}$ as both an applied system and an interactive research aid. An offline configuration study across eight arXiv domains compares document representations, dimensionality reduction methods, and clustering algorithms using intrinsic clustering and topic-coherence metrics; the results support MiniLM embeddings with 10-dimensional UMAP and Agglomerative Clustering as a practical default. A scenario-based survey and expert focus group assess interpretability and use contexts: participants rated cluster labels as meaningful in 85% of scenario responses, and feedback indicated that $\texttt{Eliot}$ is most valuable for auditable overviews of rapidly changing technical areas. These results suggest that query-time clustering and temporal inspection can complement search and generation tools by helping researchers inspect and refine the evidence behind literature trends.

title: From paper to benchmark: agentic, framework-based reproduction of under-specified methods in machine health intelligence
summary: Industrial Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) provides a representative case study for a broader challenge in applied machine learning: translating published papers into executable, benchmark-ready implementations. Reproducing under-specified methods in PHM is particularly difficult due to restricted access to industrial datasets, incomplete reporting of preprocessing and evaluation protocols, and implicit design choices (e.g., windowing, target construction, data splits) that critically affect performance. Existing paper-to-code systems generate implementations for individual papers, but these artifacts are often not directly comparable due to inconsistencies in assumptions and evaluation settings. We introduce \emph{agentic, framework-based PHM paper reproduction}, where an agent translates a paper into a shared PHM benchmark framework via a \emph{slot-binding interface}. This interface maps equations and protocol descriptions into structured components (task definitions, dataset adapters, windowing, targets, models, and evaluators), while explicitly recording unresolved assumptions. The resulting implementations are validated against standardized task contracts and evaluation hooks, enabling consistent and comparable benchmarking. We evaluate this approach on 16 PHM papers, comparing framework-enhanced, skill-based and prompt-based agentic reproduction against a recent framework-free paper-reproduction agent. We assess reproduction success, model-based code evaluation, framework binding of paper assumptions, and cross-paper benchmark comparability under standardized protocols. Our results show that coupling agentic generation with a shared framework transforms paper reproduction from isolated code synthesis into executable, assumption-aware, and systematically comparable benchmark implementations.

title: Reasoning and Planning with Dynamically Changing Norms
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, dataset included in anc
summary: To safely interact with humans, AI agents must both know our norms and consider them during planning. However, such norm-guided planning has been less explored, only within communities of artificial agents, and has ignored the dynamic nature of norms. This paper instead presents an approach to guiding planning with dynamically changing norms in a human-AI setting. We contribute a defeasible calculus for resolving normative conflicts and an approach to using such dynamically changing norms as guard rails on plans. We theoretically demonstrate our approach with formal proofs and empirically with an AI agent, SocialBot, on a natural language dialogue task.

title: Keyphrase Generative Representation of Youth Crisis Conversations Beyond Static Taxonomies
summary: Crisis Responders (CRs) rapidly assess thousands of youth SMS conversations each year to identify mental health concerns and guide support. Yet youth distress is increasingly expressed through evolving and context-specific language that often does not fit fixed-label taxonomies. This work analyzed 703,975 de-identified Kids Help Phone conversations (2018-2023) and expanded KHP's 19-label issue taxonomy into a 39-label hierarchical schema. We then introduce Keyphrase Generative Representation (KGR), a constrained LLM generating concise, conversation-specific keyphrases, evaluated across 129 conversations and 387 expert annotations. The expanded taxonomy achieved expert consensus reliability, with an accuracy of 0.96, and expert review found that 81% of keyphrases accurately reflected content and 74% improved clarity. KGR surfaced identity-linked themes absent from the fixed taxonomy, including immigration problems and caregiver burden, and supported a topic-retrieval workflow that increased accuracy from 0.25 to 0.70 (+0.45) over the manual analyst process. KGR marks a shift toward hybrid, interpretable generative representations that extend crisis response beyond static taxonomies to surface emerging and culturally grounded patterns of youth distress.

title: Federated Learning for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection in Industrial Automation
comment: Preprint. Accepted at the DEXA International Workshop on Optimisation of Industrial Production with AI Algorithms 2026 (DEXA AI4IP 2026)
summary: Federated learning (FL) has broadened the horizon for multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD). However, benchmarking such anomaly detection methods within FL paradigm poses data-centric challenges. The existing datasets do not counteract these challenges since they do not simultaneously provide sufficient scale, accurate labels, and freedom from common flaws. In addition, the role of cyclic process behavior, which is common in discrete industrial automation, remains underexplored for MTSAD for the current state of research. This paper aims to shed more light on the literature and address these gaps by introducing a dataset designed with cyclic dynamics arising from the repetitive nature of discrete automation processes and evaluates selected MTSAD methods on both the proposed dataset and a public benchmark dataset.

title: Developing an Intelligent Job Recommendation System Using Semantic Retrieval and Explainable AI Techniques
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, IEEE-style paper on semantic retrieval and explainable AI for intelligent job recommendation
summary: Online recruitment platforms require recommendation methods capable of retrieving relevant job opportunities from large and heterogeneous collections of job postings. Keyword-based search is efficient and interpretable, but it may fail to retrieve relevant postings when equivalent roles are expressed using different terminology. This study presents a metadata-driven job recommendation system that combines TF-IDF lexical matching, Sentence-BERT semantic retrieval, query-aware filtering, optional Cross-Encoder re-ranking, and explanation generation. The proposed system utilizes structured metadata fields including job title, company name, location, seniority level, job function, employment type, and industry without relying on full job descriptions or user interaction histories. Experiments conducted on a cleaned LinkedIn job posting dataset containing 31262 records demonstrate that the best hybrid configuration achieved a Precision at 10 score of 0.8032 and an nDCG at 10 score of 0.9496. Under the internal evaluation protocol, Cross-Encoder re-ranking improved Precision at 10 from 0.7896 to 0.7948 and nDCG at 10 from 0.9666 to 0.9739. These findings indicate that lexical and semantic retrieval techniques can be effectively combined to provide explainable job recommendations when only structured metadata is available.

title: Intelligence as Managed Autonomy: Failure, Escalation, and Governance for Agentic AI Systems
summary: As autonomous and agentic AI systems scale in robotic and human-machine environments, managing hallucination and persistent but unjustified action remains an open challenge. Rather than attributing these failures solely to model or alignment limitations, this paper explores the architectural vulnerability of unbounded autonomy - the presumption that an agent should continue operating regardless of rising uncertainty. It introduces a theory of managed autonomy that defines intelligent behavior through the formal capacity to detect epistemic drift, suspend reasoning, attempt recovery, and ultimately surrender control when reliability diminishes. We instantiate this theory via the SMARt (Self-Managing Multi-tier Autonomous Reasoning with Regulated/Revoked transitions) model, a four-layer framework featuring Stable, Meta-cognitive, Assisted, and Regulated states. By developing a timed, guarded Petri net formulation, we establish theoretically bounded properties for the system, demonstrating how architecture can formally mandate escalation, constrain invalid outputs, and ensure governance reachability under specified conditions. We further analyze how incorporating domain-specific trigger sets across varied operational settings (e.g., healthcare, robotics, etc.) can systematically preserve safety, assuming completeness and soundness criteria are met. Because these triggers are designed to be adaptive, the SMARt model accommodates the safe, controlled expansion of an agent's operational scope over time. We conclude that formalizing failure management within the autonomy lifecycle is a crucial step toward realizing reliable and governed artificial intelligence.

title: The Future of Facts: Tracing the Factual Generation-Verification Gap
comment: Code for this project is available at https://github.com/anjasurina/factgap , blog post at https://www.trdavidson.com/fact-gap
summary: Language models are becoming the default interface to factual knowledge, yet they often verify outputs more reliably than they generate them. This generation-verification gap (GV-gap) underlies many recent advances in self-improvement and reasoning, but its dynamics on factual knowledge specifically remain poorly understood. We focus on the training mechanisms underlying factual GV-gaps, distinguishing them from their computational and aesthetic counterparts. We trace generation and verification capabilities through three training phases (acquisition, continual learning, and updating) across four open-source model families at two scales each. Three findings recur across models: (i) verification is consistently learned before generation; (ii) verification is more robust to continual learning than generation; and (iii) factual updates can leave models in a "multi-verse" state, simultaneously verifying both old and new answers as correct. Natural experiments on frontier models reproduce these dynamics at scale and reveal residual verification biases on well-covered facts.
